If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is negative in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, increase late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment is mixed (alternating 0.5–0.67) and forecast is flat, adjust mid-period forecast upward by 0.8–1.2% to reflect uncertainty.  
If sentiment is consistently 0.00 and forecast is rising, reduce early-period forecast by 0.5–1.0% to avoid false momentum signals.  
If sentiment is consistently 1.00 and forecast is falling, increase early-period forecast by 0.5–1.0% to offset bullish bias.  
If sentiment is 0.67–0.33 and forecast is volatile, dampen mid-period forecast by 0.5–1.0% to smooth out sentiment-driven noise.
